clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements of slotted countersunk head bolts for steel structures in the dia range 10 to 24 mm.

clauses.title: Dimensions (in mm)
clauses.text: 2. Dimensions (in mm) Nominal       Nominal Dia           Range of Preferred Size Lengths (See Note 1) M10 10 20-160 M12 12 25-160 M16 16 30-160 M20 20 50-160 M22 22 55-160 M24 24 60-160 Note 1- Preferred lengths - 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45,  50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 90, 100, 110, 120, 130, 140, 150 and 160 mm. Note 2- For detailed dimensions and tolerances, refer  to Table 1 of the Standard. Note 3 - For lengths of fully threaded bolts, refer to  Table 2 of the Standard.

clauses.title: Grade – Black grade
clauses.text: 3. Grade - Black grade (B) as specified in the prescribed standard.

clauses.title: Designation – As an
clauses.text: 4. Designation - As an example, a slotted countersunk head bolt of nominal size M16, length 70 mm with nut and property class 8.8 shall be designated as `Slotted Countersunk Head Bolt M16 × 70 N IS 8412— 8.8'.

clauses.title: When the bolts are
clauses.text: 4.1 When the bolts are required without nuts, the letter `N' appearing between length and number of the standard in the designation shall be omitted.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties – Property
clauses.text: 5. Mechanical Properties - Property classes 4.6 or 8.8 of the prescribed standard.

clauses.title: General Requirements – Nuts
clauses.text: 6. General Requirements -  Nuts used with slotted countersunk head bolts shall conform to the requirements as specified in the prescribed standard. SUMMARY OF IS 8412 : 1977 SLOTTED COUNTERSUNK HEAD BOLTS FOR STEEL STRUCTURES
